summary: dellemc.openmanage in 11.9.0: iDRAC modules are compatible with ansible-core 2.19, many iDRAC modules and roles (bios, boot, certificates, reset, support_assist, user, redfish_firmware) support iDRAC10, and ome_firmware* modules support OME 4.5.
questions: Do the OpenManage iDRAC modules work with ansible-core 2.19?
Which modules support iDRAC10 as of Ansible 11.9.0?

answer_card.title: openmanage iDRAC10 and core 2.19 support
answer_card.answer_md:
- iDRAC modules are compatible with ansible-core 2.19.
- iDRAC10 support was added to `idrac_bios` (role), `idrac_boot` (module and role), `idrac_certificates`, `idrac_reset` (module and role), `idrac_support_assist`, `idrac_user` (module and role) and `redfish_firmware`.
- `ome_firmware`, `ome_firmware_baseline`, `ome_firmware_baseline_compliance_info`, `ome_firmware_baseline_info` and `ome_firmware_catalog` support OME 4.5.
